Recent Cup Run & Results

Castel Challenge Cup National Finalists

Dedza Dynamos made history in the 2025/26 campaign, reaching their first ever national cup final after edging Blue Eagles on penalties in the semi-final.

National Cup Final · 21 February 2026

FCB Nyasa Big Bullets 2–1 Dedza Dynamos

Hassan Kajoke netted twice (57' & 79') for Bullets, while Chikondi Mbeta struck back for Dedza Dynamos in the 83rd minute at a packed Bingu National Stadium. The Yellow Boys proudly finished as national runners-up.

Final Result
2 – 1
Bingu National Stadium, Lilongwe
